# Overview {.unnumbered}

The labs in this section cover topics and techniques that are applicable across different hardware platforms. These labs are designed to be independent of specific boards, so that you can focus on the concepts and algorithms used in (tiny) ML applications.

These shared labs cover the common challenges and solutions in embedded machine learning. The skills apply to whatever hardware you use later.
